name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: Cooking is needed to build a basic campfire, the foundation for surviving in the wild and setting up a campsite.
As a Horde adventurer starting out in Durotar, you can visit Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn the basics of cooking.

faq.answer: Camping 101: Cooking teaches adventurers the basics of outdoor survival. Learning to cook and make a campfire lets them establish camps in the wild.
faq.q: What is the quest Camping 101: Cooking?

faq.answer: Cook Torka is the Horde cooking trainer in Razor Hill, Durotar. He teaches aspiring adventurers cooking basics and how to light a campfire.

aliases: why do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: Cooking teaches travelers to build the campfire at the heart of a campsite. Without a fire, they cannot maintain a proper campsite in the wilderness.
faq.q: Why is cooking required for camping?

faq.answer: Once you learn the basics of cooking and making a campfire, you can set up a small campsite almost anywhere in the open wilderness. At first, it supports only a few furnishings.
faq.q: Where can an adventurer set up a campsite?

faq.answer: As you improve your cooking skill, you can learn to build larger, longer lasting campfires and expand what your campsite can support.
faq.q: How do you upgrade your campfire?

faq.answer: Cooking provides the campfire foundation, while other trade trainers across the world teach adventurers to craft and place furnishings for their campsites.
faq.q: How do you obtain furnishings for a campsite?

sections.body: Beyond a settlement's gates, surviving in the wild takes more than sharp steel and sturdy armor. In Razor Hill, Cook Torka teaches budding adventurers to cook. Across Durotar and beyond, cooking means more than preparing a hot meal. It also teaches travelers to light a reliable campfire, the heart of any campsite.
sections.title: The Hearth of the Wild

sections.body: Once travelers know the basics, they can pitch a modest camp almost anywhere on the frontier. A novice campfire supports only a few essential furnishings. Greater cooking skill lets travelers build larger blazes. Other trades teach them to craft what they need to furnish and improve a camp into a reliable shelter from the wild.
sections.title: Building and Furnishing a Camp

summary: In Razor Hill, Cook Torka shows travelers how to cook and make a campfire. With those skills, they can establish camps in the wild.
